input_case.description: Caso numerico iniziale per sviluppare il prototipo. Sostituire i valori con requisiti reali prima di usare i risultati per progettazione.
input_case.reference_note: La spinta 0.6 N è solo un ordine di grandezza ispirato al requisito pubblicato per un asse del sistema Astrobee; l'architettura qui è un rotore assiale intubato distinta da Astrobee.
limitations: Values other than the approximate thrust scale are illustrative assumptions, not measured Astrobee data.
No duct geometry is supplied; predicted thrust is rotor-model thrust and does not quantify net duct force.
Airfoil polars are not yet supplied; optimization cannot be treated as validated until suitable polars are added.
The example does not establish that the requested thrust is feasible within the assumed diameter and speed bounds.

limitations: Rotor-only preliminary BEMT; no duct or tip/hub losses.
Velocity input interpreted as far-upstream axial speed.
Numerical polars, no experimental validation or structural verification.
Local optimization from one selected feasible seed per pair; global optimum not guaranteed.
Chord, pitch, solidity and Mach bounds are provisional project choices.
Invalid BEMT points rejected with discontinuous penalty; may obstruct convergence.
